summary: Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a working capital loan facility from its sponsor. On August 25, 2026, it issued an unsecured promissory note for up to US$500,000 to ST Sponsor II Limited. The note is non-interest bearing (except default interest), payable upon business combination or liquidation, and convertible into private units at $10.00 per unit, subject to a $3,000,000 aggregate conversion cap. This is a routine SPAC working capital arrangement, not a special situation. The filing involves no merger, tender, or strategic action; it simply provides interim funding to support operations until a deal closes.
